ms.criteria:
・All components stubs are ready for feature development
・A CI/CD pipeline is in place to build / integrate the different artifacts
ms.report:
This Github PR in the Oura repository provides the initial scaffolding for adding multi-chain support to Oura. In particular, it introduces:
・An updated pipeline model that supports multiple-chains
・A stub of the Bitcoin source plugin
・A stub of the Ethereum source plugin
・A stub of the Substrate source plugin

https://github.com/txpipe/oura/pull/910
In order to accomplish this, we had to refactor the following:
・Cardano data is now namespaced under a Cardano record wrapper across filters, sinks, and sources.
・The event and data model has a clear multi-chain handling mechanism using sum types.
・All filters / sinks provide the previous behavior but with opting out of any non-Cardano chain (for the time being)

The scaffold also includes the corresponding workflows for continuous integration. In particular:
・Lint check
・Test formatting
・Unit test checks
・Integration test checks.

An example of a particular execution of the workflow can be found here:
https://github.com/txpipe/oura/actions/runs/18297621234
